question: Rapid diagnostic tests for diagnosing uncomplicated non-falciparum or Plasmodium vivax malaria in endemic countries (a diagnostic-test-accuracy review: in people with suspected non-falciparum / P. vivax malaria, what is the accuracy of rapid diagnostic tests?)
source: CLEF TAR 2018 Task 2 (Testing), content-level qrels — finally-included studies of Cochrane review CD011431.

version_change.decision_source: CLEF topic description and fixture author decisions.

review.question: Rapid diagnostic tests for diagnosing uncomplicated non-falciparum or Plasmodium vivax malaria in endemic countries (a diagnostic-test-accuracy review: in people with suspected non-falciparum / P. vivax malaria, what is the accuracy of rapid diagnostic tests?)

framework.name: PIRD
framework.rationale: Diagnostic-test-accuracy review of malaria rapid diagnostic tests; species, endemic setting, and reference standard are screened to protect recall.

slots.label: Population
slots.description: People with suspected uncomplicated non-falciparum malaria.

slots.label: Reference standard
slots.description: Eligible reference standard confirmed during screening.

inclusion.label: Eligible malaria
inclusion.description: Suspected or confirmed uncomplicated non-falciparum or P. vivax malaria.

inclusion.label: Rapid diagnostic test
inclusion.description: Evaluates a malaria rapid diagnostic test.

inclusion.label: Diagnostic evaluation
inclusion.description: Reports diagnostic performance against an eligible reference standard.

exclusion.label: Falciparum-only scope
exclusion.description: Evaluates only P. falciparum without eligible non-falciparum results.

concepts.label: Malaria
concepts.definition: Human malaria, searched broadly without requiring a species term.
concepts.rationale: Malaria is the stable condition anchor; requiring species language could miss eligible reports.

concepts.label: Rapid diagnostic tests
concepts.definition: Point-of-care rapid diagnostic tests for malaria antigen or parasite detection.
concepts.rationale: The index-test family is central and normally explicit in searchable fields.

properties.label: Non-falciparum species
properties.instructions: Confirm non-falciparum or P. vivax results during screening.
properties.recall_rationale: Species may be absent from titles and abstracts or reported only in subgroup data.

properties.label: Accuracy and reference standard
properties.instructions: Confirm eligible diagnostic-performance data and reference standard.
properties.recall_rationale: Accuracy language and reference standards are inconsistently abstracted.

properties.label: Endemic-country setting
properties.recall_rationale: A geographic/endemic-setting block would exclude eligible records with sparse location reporting.

decisions.label: Diagnostic-method filter
decisions.rationale: No diagnostic hedge is required for the recall-first search.

decisions.label: Database limits
decisions.rationale: No date, language, species, age, geographic, publication-status, or full-text limits.

recall.policy: Recall first; decline optional no-seed heuristic evaluation because hidden gold is scored independently.

workload.policy: Do not narrow solely because retrieval is large.
workload.selection_rule: Workload may choose only among variants that meet the held-out recall requirement.

notes: Diagnostic-test-accuracy review. Gold set = 26 included studies. No hand-built baseline strategy: use evals/generate.py (Phase 2) to have the skill build one. Some gold studies may predate or fall outside PubMed; the harness reports reachable vs. unreachable separately.
